policies.title: Palauan ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Palau as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Palauan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Palauan ordinary passports: Iceland visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Iceland's current visa regulation expressly places Palau in its nationality annex exempt from entry-visa requirements.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Palauan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The current regulation's general short-stay limit and border-admission requirements continue to apply.
Work, residence, special travel documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Palauan ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule includes Palau in its no-visa-required visitor cohort.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Palauan passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The cited Embassy page states a maximum three-month stay for its named no-visa-required cohort.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.
